about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Tonkotsu-Style Pork Rib Broth Ramen
recipes.summary: A milky, collagen-rich pork rib broth simmered for hours, served with noodles, soft egg and sesame.
steps: Boil the pork ribs in water for 10 minutes, then drain and rinse the ribs and pot.

Return the ribs to the pot with the fresh water, onion, garlic, ginger and spring onion and boil hard for 3 hours, topping up with hot water, until the broth turns cloudy and the meat falls off the bone.
Strain the broth and season with the soy sauce, mirin and sesame oil.
Boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes until jammy, then cool in iced water and peel.
Cook the noodles until just tender and divide among bowls.
Ladle over the hot broth and top with pulled rib meat, halved eggs and sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches at least 75°C and is falling off the bone, and serve jammy eggs only to healthy adults.
Boil hard, not gently, to get the milky broth.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin Blanc Style Chicken Soup
recipes.summary: A white-wine chicken soup with mushrooms, pearl onions and bacon, finished with cream and thyme.
steps: Brown the chicken skin side down in the butter for 8 minutes until deep golden, then lift out.
Fry the bacon, onions and mushrooms in the same pot for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, then the wine and let it reduce by half.
Return the chicken and add the stock, thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 40 minutes until the meat is falling from the bone.
Shred the meat, discard the skin and bones, stir in the cream and return the chicken.
Serve in warm bowls with the chopped parsley on top.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Cioppino San Francisco Seafood Stew
recipes.summary: A tomato and wine seafood stew with clams, prawns and white fish, finished with parsley.
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 8 minutes until translucent, then add the garlic and chilli.
Pour in the wine and reduce by half, then add the tomatoes, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 25 minutes until rich.
Add the fish and clams, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the mussels and prawns and cook for 3 minutes until the shells open and the prawns are pink and opaque.
Discard any shellfish that stay shut and finish with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, the prawns until pink and opaque, and discard any shells that do not open.
Serve with sourdough.

recipes.title: Duck and Mushroom Consomme Dumpling Soup
recipes.summary: A clear spiced duck broth with delicate duck and mushroom dumplings.
steps: Simmer the duck legs with the water, star anise, ginger and spring onions for 90 minutes, skimming, until the meat is tender.
Lift out the duck, shred the meat and strain the broth.
Fry the mushrooms in the sesame oil for 6 minutes until golden, then mix with half the duck, shaoxing wine and half the soy.
Fold spoonfuls into wonton wrappers, sealing the edges with water.
Season the broth with the remaining soy and pepper and bring to a simmer until steaming.
Cook the dumplings for 4 minutes until they float and the filling is hot.
Serve with sliced spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the duck until it reaches 75°C and is fork tender.
Save the remaining duck for another meal.

recipes.title: Cassava Leaf Style Greens in Peanut Sauce
recipes.summary: Silky greens stewed in a peanut and tomato sauce, a Sierra Leone-inspired side.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the tomatoes and scotch bonnet and cook for 8 minutes until reduced.
Whisk in the peanut butter and water until smooth.
Add the kale and simmer for 20 minutes until completely tender and the oil rises.
Season with salt and remove the scotch bonnet.
notes: Serve over rice or with plantain.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Light Soup with Chicken and Eggplant
recipes.summary: A thin, peppery tomato soup with chicken, eggplant and ginger.
steps: Blend the onion, tomatoes, ginger and scotch bonnet until smooth.
Pour into a pot with the chicken, water and salt.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the eggplant and simmer for 10 minutes until soft.
Season with the pepper and serve hot with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Serve with rice balls or fufu.

recipes.title: Rawon-Inspired Black Beef Soup
recipes.summary: An East Javanese beef soup with a dark spice paste, lemongrass and lime leaves.
steps: Blitz the shallots, garlic, macadamias, coriander, turmeric and galangal to a paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 8 minutes until fragrant and darker.
Add the beef, water, lemongrass, lime leaves, dark soy and salt.
Simmer for 2 hours until the beef is very tender.
Serve topped with bean sprouts and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 75°C.
Serve with rice and sambal.

recipes.title: Rice Flour Crepes with Cream Cheese and Warm Berries
recipes.summary: Delicate gluten-free crepes made with rice flour, filled with berries and cream cheese.
steps: Whisk the rice flour, cornflour, eggs, milk, melted butter and salt until smooth, then rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan and add a thin layer of batter.
Cook for 1 minute each side until pale gold and set, making 8 crepes.
Warm the berries with the honey for 3 minutes until juicy.
Spread the crepes with cream cheese, fill with berries and fold.
notes: Food safety: cook the crepes until the egg is fully set.
Rest time is not counted in the prep time.

recipes.title: Smoky Kumara and Black Bean Pan Hash
recipes.summary: A vegan, gluten-free hash of diced sweet potato, black beans, capsicum and lime.
steps: Fry the sweet potato in the oil for 12 minutes, stirring, until golden and tender.
Add the onion and capsicum for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spices and beans and cook for 4 minutes until hot.
Finish with the lime juice and coriander and top with avocado.
notes: Add fried eggs for extra protein.
Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Moroccan Spiced Chickpea Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: A vegan, high-protein bowl of warm spiced chickpeas, tomato and herbs with tahini.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the chickpeas for 6 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Add the ras el hanout, garlic and tomatoes for 4 minutes until jammy.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and a splash of water until pourable.
Spoon into bowls and drizzle with tahini.
notes: Serve with flatbread.
Naturally vegan and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Soaked Oats with Grated Apple, Maple and Crunchy Walnuts
recipes.summary: Creamy no-cook oats soaked in oat milk with grated apple, cinnamon and walnuts.
steps: Stir the oats, oat milk, apple, cinnamon and maple syrup together.
Cover and chill overnight until thick and creamy.
Loosen with the soy milk if needed.
Top with the walnuts and serve cold.
notes: Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.
Warm gently if you prefer it hot, until steaming.

recipes.title: Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Honey, Pistachios and Pomegranate
recipes.summary: A high-protein Greek yoghurt bowl with honey, pistachios and pomegranate.
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into bowls.
Drizzle generously with the honey.
Top with the pistachios, pomegranate, cardamom and sesame seeds until the bowl is full of texture.
notes: High in protein and quick to assemble.
Use a dairy-free yoghurt if needed.

recipes.title: Smoky Lentil and Sweet Potato Soup
recipes.summary: A thick vegan soup of red lentils, sweet potato and smoked paprika, high in fibre.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until translucent.
Add the garlic, paprika and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, sweet potato and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils collapse and the sweet potato is soft.
Blend half the soup for a thick texture and add the lemon juice.
notes: Naturally vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Ginger Miso Mushroom Soup
recipes.summary: A vegan umami-rich broth of shiitake, ginger and miso with silken tofu.
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger and mushrooms for 12 minutes until the mushrooms are tender.
Add the tofu and soy sauce and heat for 3 minutes.
Remove from the heat, whisk in the miso and sesame oil.
Serve hot with the sliced spring onion on top.
notes: Do not boil after adding the miso.
Naturally vegan; check the miso for gluten.

recipes.title: Cold Cucumber Dill Soup Thickened with Greek Yoghurt
recipes.summary: A refreshing cold soup of cucumber, yoghurt, dill and mint, high in protein.
steps: Blend the cucumber, yoghurt, garlic, dill and mint until smooth.
Thin with the water and stir in the oil, lemon juice and salt.
Chill for at least 1 hour until very cold.
Serve with a drizzle of oil.
notes: Serve in chilled bowls.
Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Corn Fritters with Avocado
recipes.summary: Crisp fritters made with corn, chickpea flour and herbs, served with avocado and lime.
steps: Mix the corn, chickpea flour, egg, milk, spring onions, cumin and salt into a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Spoon in the batter and fry for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked in the middle.
Serve with the avocado and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the fritters until set in the middle.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Dairy-Free Spinach and Pea Soup with Coconut
recipes.summary: A vivid green vegan soup with peas, spinach and a splash of coconut cream.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes until translucent.
Add the stock and peas and simmer for 8 minutes until tender.
Add the spinach until wilted, then blend until smooth.
Stir in the coconut cream and lemon juice and heat gently.
Serve hot or cold with the torn mint on top.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.
Serve cold in summer.

recipes.title: Smoky Tofu Rice Paper Salad Rolls
recipes.summary: Fresh rolls of smoky tofu, vermicelli, herbs and crunchy vegetables with peanut dipping sauce.
steps: Fry the tofu with the soy sauce and paprika in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Soak the vermicelli in hot water until soft, then drain.
Soften one rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds until pliable.
Fill with tofu, noodles, vegetables and herbs, then roll tightly.
Whisk the peanut butter, sweet chilli, lime juice and a splash of warm water until pourable.
Serve the rolls with the sauce.
notes: Keep rolls under a damp cloth until serving.
Naturally vegan; check the sweet chilli sauce for fish.

recipes.title: Chargrilled Corn and Black Bean Salad
recipes.summary: A smoky vegan salad of grilled corn, black beans, tomato and avocado with lime.
steps: Char the corn on a hot grill for 10 minutes, turning, until blackened in spots.
Cut off the kernels with a sharp knife and discard the cobs.
Mix the kernels with the beans, tomatoes, onion and coriander.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt and toss through.
Fold in the avocado gently.
notes: Naturally gluten-free and dairy-free.
Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Za'atar Roasted Cauliflower and Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: A vegan, gluten-free salad of roast cauliflower, crisp chickpeas, parsley and a lemony tahini.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large baking tray.
Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with the oil and zaatar.
Roast for 30 minutes until the cauliflower is golden and the chickpeas are crisp.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and water until smooth.
Toss the roasted vegetables with the parsley and onion and drizzle with the dressing.
notes: Naturally dairy-free.
Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Maple Pumpkin and Pepita Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: A vegan, gluten-free salad with roast pumpkin, quinoa, pepitas and a maple dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and roast the pumpkin with 1 tbsp oil for 30 minutes until golden.
Simmer the quinoa in 400ml water for 15 minutes until tender with a visible curl.
Whisk the remaining oil, maple syrup, vinegar and mustard.
Toss the warm quinoa with the pumpkin, spinach, onion and dressing.
Top with the pumpkin seeds.
notes: Naturally dairy-free.
Check the mustard for gluten if serving coeliacs.

recipes.title: Pineapple Mango Slaw with Lime and Chilli
recipes.summary: A bright, crunchy slaw of cabbage, pineapple and mango with a lime and chilli dressing.
steps: Mix the cabbage, mango, pineapple, carrot, chilli and coriander.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, honey and salt.
Toss through the slaw until coated.
Rest for 10 minutes until the cabbage softens slightly.
notes: Serve with jerk chicken or fish.
Use maple syrup for vegan.

recipes.title: Cape Malay Carrot Salad with Raisins
recipes.summary: A sweet and spiced grated carrot salad with raisins, lemon and cinnamon.
steps: Mix the carrot and raisins in a bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, cinnamon, sugar and salt.
Toss through the carrots and rest for 15 minutes until the flavours mingle.
Top with the torn mint and serve at room temperature.
notes: Serve with curries and braai meats.
Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Urap Sayur Indonesian Vegetable Salad with Coconut
recipes.summary: Blanched vegetables dressed with a spiced coconut mix.
steps: Blanch the beans for 3 minutes, then add the cabbage and sprouts for 1 minute until just tender, and drain.
Crush the garlic, chillies, palm sugar and salt to a paste.
Mix with the coconut and lime leaves.
Toss the vegetables with the coconut mix and lime juice.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
Serve with rice and tempeh-style fried tofu.

recipes.title: Pacific Coconut Rice Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm coconut rice porridge topped with pineapple, toasted coconut and lime.
steps: Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, water, sugar and salt, stirring often, for 25 minutes until creamy.
Toast the coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Spoon the porridge into bowls.
Top with pineapple, coconut and lime zest.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
Refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.

recipes.title: Samoan Style Oka Cooked Fish Salad with Coconut
recipes.summary: Poached white fish with cucumber, tomato, onion and coconut cream dressing.
steps: Poach the fish in simmering water for 5 minutes until opaque and flaking, then cool and flake.
Mix the cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Whisk the coconut cream, lime juice, chilli and salt.
Fold the fish and dressing through the vegetables.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, with an internal temperature of at least 63°C.
The traditional version uses raw fish; this cooked version is safer.

recipes.title: Fiji-Style Rourou Greens with Coconut Milk
recipes.summary: Silky stewed greens in coconut milk with onion, garlic and chilli.
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the spinach until wilted, then pour in the coconut milk.
Simmer for 10 minutes until creamy and thickened.
Season with the salt and simmer until glossy, then serve hot with roast fish or meat.
notes: Traditionally made with taro leaves.
Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Pelau Style Chicken and Pigeon Pea Rice
recipes.summary: One-pot caramelised chicken and rice with beans, coconut and thyme.
steps: Caramelise the sugar in the oil for 2 minutes until dark amber, then add the chicken and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the rice, beans, coconut milk, stock, thyme and whole scotch bonnet.
Cover and cook on low heat for 22 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Rest for 10 minutes and fluff.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C, and refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.
Leave the scotch bonnet whole.

recipes.title: Jamaican Red Pea Soup with Beef
recipes.summary: Beef and kidney bean soup with root vegetables and spinners, thick with thyme and allspice.
steps: Simmer the beef with the water, thyme, allspice and scotch bonnet for 75 minutes until nearly tender.
Add the beans, sweet potato and carrot and simmer for 20 minutes.
Mix the flour with a pinch of salt and enough water to make a firm dough, then roll into thin spinners.
Stir in the coconut milk and drop in the spinners.
Cook for 10 minutes until the spinners are firm and the beef is falling apart.
Add the spring onions and remove the scotch bonnet.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 75°C.
Leave the scotch bonnet whole.

recipes.title: Pepperpot Style Beef and Callaloo Stew Soup
recipes.summary: A dark, aromatic beef soup with spinach, okra, thyme and cinnamon.
steps: Simmer the beef with the water, onion, garlic, cinnamon, thyme and scotch bonnet for 75 minutes until tender.
Add the soy sauce, sugar and okra and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the spinach until wilted.
Season with salt and remove the scotch bonnet.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender, with an internal temperature of at least 75°C.
Serve with rice or dumplings.

recipes.title: Bacon and Egg Mealie Meal Breakfast Bake
recipes.summary: A baked polenta breakfast bake with bacon, tomato and eggs.
steps: Cook the polenta in the salted water for 12 minutes, stirring, until thick, then spread into a baking dish.
Heat the oven to 200°C and grease a baking dish.
Fry the bacon for 6 minutes until crisp and scatter over the polenta with the tomatoes.
Make six wells, crack in the eggs and top with the cheddar.
Bake for 15 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with the chives and serve in squares.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg whites are completely set and the bacon is cooked through.
Cook yolks firm for vulnerable eaters.

recipes.title: Boerewors-Style Sausage Hash with Tomato Relish
recipes.summary: Crisp potato and spiced sausage hash with chakalaka-style tomato.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Fry the sausage in the oil for 6 minutes until browned.
Add the potatoes, onion and capsicum and fry for 10 minutes until crisp.
Stir in the spices and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Make four wells and cook the eggs for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausage until it reaches 75°C with no pink, and the egg whites until set.
Serve with chutney.

recipes.title: Pho Ga Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: A clear ginger and onion chicken broth with rice noodles, shredded chicken and herbs.
steps: Char the onion and ginger in a dry pan for 5 minutes until blackened.
Simmer the chicken with the water, charred aromatics and spices for 40 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and strain the broth, seasoning with fish sauce.
Soak the noodles in hot water until soft and divide among bowls.
Top with chicken, ladle over the hot broth and finish with the herbs, sprouts, spring onion and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Skim off fat for a cleaner broth.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Sauce for Grilled Skewers
recipes.summary: A smooth, sweet-spicy peanut sauce for satay, gado-gado and salad rolls.
steps: Warm the coconut milk and peanut butter in a pot, stirring, until smooth.
Add the kecap manis, lime juice, garlic, ginger, chilli and sugar.
Simmer for 5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Loosen with water if needed.
notes: Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.
Reheat gently until warm.

recipes.title: Mango Avocado Salsa with Lime
recipes.summary: A fresh, vegan salsa of mango, avocado, red onion and lime.
steps: Mix the mango, avocado, onion, jalapeno and coriander gently.
Add the lime juice and salt until just combined.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve.
notes: Serve with grilled fish or corn chips.
Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Tamarind and Ginger Chutney
recipes.summary: A sweet-sour tamarind and ginger chutney for samosas, chaat and snacks.
steps: Simmer the tamarind, water and sugar for 10 minutes.
Add the ginger, cumin, chilli and salt.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick and syrupy.
Cool the chutney, then strain into a clean jar.
notes: Keeps for 3 weeks in the fridge.
Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Parsley and Oregano Chimichurri
recipes.summary: A bright Argentine herb sauce of parsley, garlic and red wine vinegar for grilled meat and vegetables.
steps: Mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, chilli and salt.
Stir in the vinegar and oil until combined.
Rest for 30 minutes until the flavours blend.
Spoon over steak or roast vegetables once the flavours have rested until fragrant.
notes: Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.
Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic and White Bean Dip
recipes.summary: A creamy vegan dip of roast garlic, cannellini beans and lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and roast the garlic bulb with a drizzle of oil for 40 minutes until soft and golden.
Squeeze the garlic into a blender with the beans, remaining oil, lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Blend for 2 minutes until completely smooth, scraping down the sides.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the paprika.
notes: Vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free.
Serve with vegetable sticks.

recipes.title: Jollof Style Tomato Rice with Peppers
recipes.summary: Smoky tomato and pepper rice from West Africa, cooked until the grains are fluffy and fragrant.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, capsicums and scotch bonnet to a smooth purée.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft, add the tomato paste for 3 minutes, then the purée and cook for 15 minutes until reduced and dark.
Stir in the thyme, curry powder, bay leaf and stock and bring to a simmer until steaming.
Add the rinsed rice, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 22 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes and fluff.
notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within an hour, reheating until steaming hot.
Vegan and gluten-free.
